page.layout: One column of running text, with a signature line below it and a page number and running head at the top. A library stamp sits at the foot and is omitted.

main_text.p: non omnino malè, meo judicio, definiri Jurisconsultus hac ratione posse videatur: Qui tum Juris civilis, tum ęqui[?] boniq; peritus, populo se ad a-gendum, cavendum, interpretandum, respondendumq; dedit. Quibus omnibus de rebus operæprecium esse arbitror, singulatim atque ordine differere, ut primùm quib. in rebus Jurisconsultorum munus positum, dein-quorum illud proprium fuerit, tum quæ auctoritas illorum extiterit, postremò quę nobis hodie ratio Juris inter-pretandi optima esse videatur, breviter, quantum facul-tas
main_text.notes: Doubtful: "ęqui" (the letter before "qui" is read as ę with a cedilla-like mark). Some line-end hyphens were judged by the printed hyphen: "interpretandum" and "operæprecium" are unhyphenated at line ends and are written whole. "boniq;" is written whole as the line break has no hyphen. Library stamp at the foot omitted.
